title: Make marketplace-confirmation scheduler locks pool-safe and expose persistent lock skips

acceptanceCriteria.description: Scheduler, carrier-snapshot, and rate-browse paths own no pooled session advisory lock; cross-process sync admission delegates to the queue lane's transaction-scoped advisory lock or the durable unique rate-job fence.
The simulated pooled unlock-miss strands session ownership while transaction completion releases the replacement ownership without a separate unlock statement.
Repeated lock-held skips are recorded as skipped telemetry and become a failed fulfillment-outbox deep-health component after the canonical three-cadence age budget; success clears the streak.
The post-deploy transaction-read-only production inspection finds no affected legacy or unnamed idle advisory lock, including the former carrier-snapshot and fulfillment-outbox session keys.

Marketplace-confirmation retry, restart, concurrency, fencing, starvation, source-of-truth, lockdown, strict TypeScript, and production frontend build gates remain green without a live provider side effect.

canonicalOwners: src/services/sync-job-queue.ts registerWorker for durable cross-process job admission and skip recording
src/services/sync-lane-lock.ts withSyncLaneAdvisoryLock for transaction-scoped lane ownership
src/services/worker-job-skip-health.ts for persistent fulfillment-outbox skip health
src/services/rate-browse-job-store.ts plus drizzle/0067_durable_worker_execution_fences.sql for durable rate-workflow admission

wrappers.delegatesTo: queue-owned cross-process admission while retaining only process-local promise coalescing

sotBypass.details: The queue and transaction lock remain the backend admission owners. Health is backend-owned, and no frontend, route, or provider adapter chooses lock, marketplace-confirmation, or job-liveness truth.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-439-session-advisory-locks && npm run test:sync-advisory-lock && npm run test:ps-463-leader-skip-health
evidence.proves: The canonical owner is pool-safe, affected duplicate lock owners are absent, and the current age-based skip policy is deterministic and fail-closed.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-432-sync-fulfillment-resilience && npm run test:shipment-confirmation-auto-recovery
evidence.proves: Durable marketplace-confirmation recovery remains idempotent across lost responses and restarts without notifying a live provider.
The one intentional reserved leadership session keeps consumer registration single-owner across acquisition, loss, handoff, and shutdown.
Injected contention, timeout, and starvation scenarios preserve the durable lane and marketplace-confirmation recovery boundary.

evidence.command: DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=<local production env> npm run diagnose:ps-439-advisory-locks
evidence.proves: The deployed PS-439 implementation has no stranded affected legacy advisory lock in production while the expected dedicated leader and active xact lane remain distinguishable.
Production readiness is healthy and the fulfillment-outbox component is independently healthy and observable; the unrelated stale order-sync account remains separately classified.
Repository-wide ownership, durability, runtime-schema, safety, and lifecycle guards remain green at the reviewed SHA.
Worker telemetry, health, scheduler, and all callers compile under strict TypeScript.
The backend-only lock and closeout work introduces no frontend build regression.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-245-lockdown-fence && npm run test:order-editable-lockdown
evidence.proves: PS-439 changes coordination and health only; shipped/cancelled mutation guards and protected files are unchanged.

migrations.rollbackPlan: No migration or production data change exists. Forward-revert the closeout-only reviewed commit and redeploy the prior stable tip; retain the earlier pool-safe runtime implementation.

rollback.strategy: Forward-revert a55efc85c3c0fd079eaca8606032144c10689eec and redeploy 0f3d3b571c939886dc22fb26b7455c7e5a0b76e8. This reverts only closeout documentation and a stale test assertion while retaining the deployed PS-439 pool-safe runtime implementation.

liveVerification.reason: The deployed revision is a descendant of the PS-439 implementation. Transaction-read-only production pg_locks inspection cleared every affected legacy key, production readiness returned ready, and fulfillment-outbox deep health was green without any provider or business-data mutation.

caveats.description: The card's broad idle-lock wording is reconciled: the dedicated stately-consumer leadership session is intentional, reserved on one direct/session-mode connection, and explicitly separated from the forbidden pooled handler locks.

No competing lock was created in production. The required pooled unlock-miss is simulated offline and paired with a transaction-read-only post-deploy lock inspection; this preserves production safety without overstating the test as a live two-session mutation drill.
